name: llamaindex-buffer
about: llama-index-core ChatMemoryBuffer (deprecated in favor of Memory in this release): token_limit is the budget, tokenizer_fn is the harness's counter of a text (ceil(bytes / 4)). The library counts the joined message texts, so the adapter pads each message text with the 16 framing bytes that the harness counts, and then the library counts what the harness counts. The system message stays outside the buffer, as in a chat engine, and its tokens go in as initial_token_count. When even the newest message passes the limit, the buffer returns that message alone. To keep the library's quadratic loop affordable on long chats, the adapter gives the buffer only the newest messages that can matter (the fewest whose text passes the limit): the result is the same as with the whole chat. Pure Python, no model; the default tokenizer (tiktoken, which downloads a file) is never used.
